title: Escaping my dream world PT 2
content: (For context this is a real dream I've had and is not made up) This is the other exit. So my first ever dream I'd have about it was it was the exit was a giant chain link fence(like a dog park fence) with other fences around everywhere, cement and dead grass was everywhere. The world was ended and gone and the road was no more. Everytime I'd make it do that checkpoint. Zombies would appear soon and attack and immediately I'd know I was dreaming. When I was very very little that was how I'd be able to tell it was 'fake' or 'just a dream' So early on I could lucid dream. Eventually as I got older I stopped going to the fence because it was too predictable. After that I found the road to leave town. But it was like another version of the one in part 1. Unfortunately the road was destroyed, it had a passing lane on one side not just one on each, had medians, the cliff was higher up. Evertime the vehicle never made it out, I always fell or died and I tried walking but the dream world wouldnt let me it was too steep. I've had this dream so many times I no longer try to exit that way and I know I cant escape the town. I haven't explored all of the town but knowing the exits are blocked in a spiritual way. I feel like it's my own personal mind jail. I hate sleeping and have developed somniphobia from these over 'imaginative dreams'.
